XN  this  appeal  the  question  raised  was,  whether  an 
award  of  Mr.  Frere^  the  agent  of  the  Bombay  Govern- 
ment at  Surat^  made  upon  a  submission  to  arbitra- 
tion by  the  Appellants  and  Eespondent,  was  within 
the  provisions  of  the  Bombay  Eegulation,  ]NJ"o.  YTI.  of 
1827,  so  as  to  entitle  it  to  the  force  of  a  decree  of 
Court,  or  had  the  effect  only  of  an  ordinary  award. 
The  Order  of  the  Sudder  Dewanny  Court  appealed 
from,  directed  the  award  to  be  enforced  as  a  decree  of 
Cornet  against  the  A|)pellants.
